# Support

zakwas is maintained by one person, so answers are best effort. Where to go:

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| A first-use problem, an error message, or a surprise in `zakwas plan` | [docs/troubleshooting.md](../docs/troubleshooting.md) |
| A question about a config key or command | [docs/config.md](../docs/config.md), [docs/commands.md](../docs/commands.md), [docs/recipes.md](../docs/recipes.md) |
| Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) | [docs/agents.md](../docs/agents.md) |
| A bug | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/Automaat/zakwas/issues/new?template=bug.yml) |
| An idea for a module, option or command | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/Automaat/zakwas/issues/new?template=feature.yml) |
| An agent that zakwas does not support | [Open a provider request](https://github.com/Automaat/zakwas/issues/new?template=provider.yml) |
| Something that is not a bug or a feature | [Ask a question](https://github.com/Automaat/zakwas/issues/new?template=question.yml) |
| A security problem | [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md): report it privately, never as an issue |
| A conduct problem | [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |

Before you open an issue, run `zakwas version` and `zakwas plan --diff`, and remove anything private from the output (paths, tokens, email addresses). A report that includes the plan output, the relevant part of `zakwas.yaml` and your macOS version can be answered much faster.
